verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs explicitly document dbt integration via the dbt-duckdb adapter, noting the only change needed is the `path:` setting for MotherDuck, and evidence shows dbt workloads sized to specific instances (e.g. 'run dbt workloads on a Standard'), indicating dbt is a recognized first-class workflow. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report of a real dbt run against MotherDuck, and no dedicated MotherDuck-branded dbt adapter (relies on community dbt-duckdb rather than a vendor-authored adapter).
